body:
render_normal calls tracker.events.note_count per issue, which reads and json-parses the entire .events.jsonl for each ticket. `list -a` on a ~150-ticket tracker does ~150 file parses just to print notes=N.

Not a problem today — only act if a large tracker actually hurts. Cheap option then: count note lines with a substring check instead of json.loads, or cache counts. Filed at p5 deliberately; speculative optimization otherwise.
title: Avoid full event-log JSON parse per issue in list normal format
